value.title: PA wakes once on prime activity after a worker-idle episode

sections.name: summary
sections.value: One coder implements the prime-active wake as written in impl-guide.dd.json tk-0001: red tests first, then the tracker, the wiring, mutation receipts, docs, gates and the PR. Context: PaWatchdog::round (crates/daemon/src/pa_watchdog.rs:278) is the composition root; IdleEdge and fleet_working are in crates/core/src/watchdog.rs; tests use the fakes in pa_watchdog_tests.rs. Hazard: #42, so edit by absolute path only.

value.title: Red tests on main 19953b2 for AC1-AC7
PrimeActive tracker in core plus wiring in PaWatchdog::round with the spine delivery brake and audits

tk-0001.assertion: cargo test -p pij-daemon pa_watchdog shows the new cases failing on the base tree for the right reason (no wake sent), with the receipt recorded in the execution log

Cases covered: overnight resume, prime turn before arming, delivery after arming (disarms and keeps the cap) then a later self-start wakes, a PA report between ticks plus a delivery, a second prime turn capped, a usage-limit stop, a daemon restart, a new worker episode re-arms

tk-0002.assertion: All task-1 tests are green; #52's two-PA test is updated to expect one prime-active wake per PA per episode, and every other #52 test is unchanged and green
Every verdict (sent, braked, capped, no-prime, idle-on-limit) writes a watchdog.round audit, and a cold wake writes send.cold-wake-forced with reason prime-active

tk-0003.assertion: Deleting the brake turns the delivery-brake test red; deleting the cap turns the second-turn test red; both are restored and recorded in the PR

tk-0004.assertion: docs/how/pa-watchdog.md covers the idle edge, F1, limit-reset with epoch and timezone handling, prime-active with its brake and cap, the audit kinds and the cold-wake interaction; skills/pij/references/prime/pa.md links to it

tk-0005.assertion: harness checks passes (stage by stage under C12); a PR opens on pij-fleet with the plan's AC evidence (harness plan pr-body); GitHub CI is green; git ls-remote origin 'refs/notes/*' is empty
